correctness.rationale: Clearing the two strictly positive logistic denominators gives the real exponential polynomial G(x)=(1-2x)+(1-x)e^{a(x)}-x e^{b(x)} with a,b affine; exponent multiplicity budget <=6, so the extended Chebyshev zero theorem bounds real zeros by five with multiplicity. G(0)>0 and G(1)<0, and separate stable fixed points need intervening unstable zeros, bounding attractors by three. For symmetric payoffs, G_L is antisymmetric about x=1/2, its center derivative -2+(3L-2)e^(-L/2)<0 by the strict inequality 3z<1+e^z. On (0,1/3), each G_L(x) decreases strictly from positive at L=0 to -infinity, defining a unique crossing L_c(x). It diverges at endpoints; its interior minimum exists and the global five-zero budget forces the critical fold at a unique x and to have exactly double multiplicity. For L above the minimum, two left zeros and two reflected right zeros saturate the five-zero bound and alternate stable/unstable types. Rational exponential Taylor bounds imply G_3(1/6)<0, so the upper limit is sharp, attained at positive temperature. Independent symbolic antisymmetry check and high precision numerical diagnostics found L*=2.8034861721, with 1 and 5 sign-changing zeros on representative sides. Numerics never substitute for the all-parameter proof.

originality.rationale: Aguilar-Janita et al. (arXiv:2308.00860, Phys Rev E 2024) already display the coexistence and the two saddle-node transitions around theta~0.18 in their Fig. 5. The existence and qualitative bifurcation are prior and not claimed as novel. Their inspected analytic/numerical exposition does not establish the universal <=5 root multiplicity bound for all payoff matrices or uniqueness/nondegeneracy of a single simultaneous fold in the symmetric family. The extended Chebyshev root bound is also old; originality concerns its sharp application plus the complete exact phase diagram, not a new approximation-theory theorem.
residual_risks: Published numerical 0.18 bifurcation already anticipates the shape; only the exact global uniqueness, multiplicity and uniform capacity are assessed as new.
An analytic follow-up or supplementary appendix might prove the same exact bifurcation theorem.

value.rationale: A sharp parameter-independent upper bound on equilibrium and stable-state capacity, combined with an exhaustive exact symmetric rationality transition, addresses a natural nonlinear dynamical-system question beyond a numerical phase diagram. The exact fold uniqueness/multiplicity and global ceiling are independently useful.

final_claim: For all admissible positive-temperature affine aspiration payoffs, the two-strategy mean-field drift has <=5 interior zeros counted with multiplicity and <=3 asymptotically stable equilibria, with sharpness. The symmetric coordination game has a unique nondegenerate simultaneous reflected saddle-node threshold L*=2.803486..., with 1/3/5 equilibria as L crosses the threshold.
limitations: Positive temperature and nonzero normalization for deterministic infinite-population well-mixed ODE only.
No stochastic stationary distribution, finite-population escape, general network or zero-temperature result.
